## Briefing
kind: visible
title: Your website now runs on faster hosting
outcome: This week your website moved to faster hosting, in all seven languages. It looks and works the same.

notes.example/site-1#195: Your visitors can now upload PDFs that work, and see what went wrong if an upload fails instead of a blank error message.
notes.example/site-1#197: Cleaned up your customer pages by removing an old preview feature, making activity labels clearer in plain English, and fixing a bug where older customer activity would disappear from view.
notes.example/site-1#198: Your staff can now record a child's first name and date of birth when they set up a customer, so you have the information you need in one place.
notes.example/site-1#200: Your data exports now include your birth date, when you signed up, and your notification choices.
notes.example/site-1#201: Your portal now works like an app on phones, with tabs at the bottom, stacked cards instead of tables, and a cleaner dashboard that fits smaller screens.
notes.example/site-1#205: Visitors can no longer see accounts that have been fully erased, and their personal data is removed from connected services like payment and email providers, though invoices and clinical records are kept for legal reasons.
notes.example/site-1#238: Referral and enquiry forms now collect the child's name and birthdate when parents sign up, and your staff can see how many customer profiles are missing these details.
